legend: A diffuse infiltrate of monotonous medium-sized cells with a starry-sky pattern.
The cells appear cohesive with squared-off boarders, basophilic cytoplasm, and small nucleoli.
The cells are positive for CD10.
Strong expression of MYC is present in the majority (> 80%) of the cells.
Nearly 100% of cells are positive for Ki-67.
